title: Narrative Text
ringkas: Struktur cerita, past tense, dan urutan kejadian
goals: memakai **simple past** dan **past continuous** untuk menceritakan kejadian
memakai kata penghubung cerita: [[once upon a time]], [[one day]], [[suddenly]], [[while]], [[when]], [[finally]]
mengenali tokoh, latar (setting), masalah, dan penyelesaian dalam sebuah cerita
membaca dongeng dan cerita rakyat lalu menjawab pertanyaan tentang isinya
menceritakan kembali sebuah cerita sederhana dengan urutan yang jelas

lesson.text: Dongeng, cerita rakyat, fabel, sampai cerita pendek di buku: semuanya adalah **narrative text**, yaitu teks yang **menghibur** pembacanya lewat cerita yang punya **masalah** dan **penyelesaian**. Berbeda dengan recount yang menceritakan pengalaman nyata, narrative boleh berupa cerita khayalan. Di kelas 8 kamu sudah mengenal dasarnya. Sekarang kamu belajar menyusunnya dengan lengkap.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur narrative text
table: [[Once upon a time, a poor boy lived in a small village.]]
[[One day, a big storm destroyed his house.]]
Perasaan atau penilaian tokoh atas masalah
[[Finally, the villagers helped him build a new house.]]

lesson.title: 2. Ciri kebahasaan
table: [[He was walking when he heard a noise.]]

items.ex: The main character is a clever mouse.
The setting of the story is a forest.
The plot is easy to follow.
The problem is that the river is too wide.
The solution is to build a bridge.
The moral value is: be honest.
The king ruled a big kingdom.
A farmer lived in a small village.
The bear slept in a cave.
The greedy man wanted all the gold.
The brave girl saved her brother.

lesson.title: 4. Simple past dan past continuous
lesson.text: **Simple past** menceritakan kejadian yang selesai. **Past continuous** (was/were + V-ing) menceritakan kegiatan yang **sedang berlangsung** ketika kejadian lain terjadi. Hubungkan keduanya dengan **when** dan **while**.
table: [[The farmer was sleeping under a tree.]]
[[While the farmer was sleeping, the rabbit ate his carrots.]]
[[The farmer was sleeping when the rabbit came.]]

lesson.title: Jangan campur bentuk waktu
lesson.text: Benar: [[She was cooking when the lights went out.]] Salah: *She cooking when the lights go out.* Dalam cerita, pakai **past tense** secara konsisten.

lesson.title: 5. Kata penghubung dalam cerita
table: [[Once upon a time, there was a king.]]
[[It was dark, so he lit a candle.]]

lines.en: Once upon a time, a little mouse lived in a big forest. He was small, but he was very clever.
lines.id: Pada suatu hari dahulu, seekor tikus kecil tinggal di hutan yang besar. Dia kecil, tetapi sangat cerdik.

lines.en: One day, a hungry cat saw the mouse. "I will eat you!" said the cat. The mouse was very afraid.
lines.id: Suatu hari, seekor kucing yang lapar melihat tikus itu. "Aku akan memakanmu!" kata kucing. Tikus itu sangat takut.

lines.en: Suddenly, the mouse said, "Wait! I am too thin. Look at the river. There are fat fish in it."
lines.id: Tiba-tiba tikus berkata, "Tunggu! Aku terlalu kurus. Lihat sungai itu. Ada ikan gemuk di sana."

lines.en: The cat looked at the river. While he was looking at the fish, the mouse ran into a small hole. The cat could not catch him.
lines.id: Kucing melihat ke sungai. Selagi dia memandangi ikan, tikus berlari ke lubang kecil. Kucing tidak bisa menangkapnya.

lines.en: The moral value: a clever mind can save you from danger.
lines.id: Pesan moral: pikiran yang cerdik dapat menyelamatkanmu dari bahaya.

lines.en: Long ago, an honest woodcutter lived near a river. Every day he cut wood and sold it in the market.
lines.id: Dahulu kala, seorang penebang kayu yang jujur tinggal di dekat sungai. Setiap hari dia menebang kayu dan menjualnya di pasar.

lines.en: One day, while he was cutting a tree, his axe fell into the river. He could not swim, so he sat down and cried.
lines.id: Suatu hari, ketika dia sedang menebang pohon, kapaknya jatuh ke sungai. Dia tidak bisa berenang, jadi dia duduk dan menangis.

lines.en: He was very sad because the axe was his only tool.
lines.id: Dia sangat sedih karena kapak itu satu-satunya alatnya.

lines.en: Suddenly, a kind spirit came out of the water with a gold axe. "Is this yours?" she asked. "No," said the woodcutter. At last, she gave him his old axe and a gold one because he was honest.
lines.id: Tiba-tiba, seorang peri baik hati keluar dari air membawa kapak emas. "Apakah ini milikmu?" tanyanya. "Bukan," kata penebang kayu. Akhirnya, dia memberinya kapak lamanya dan juga kapak emas karena dia jujur.

lines.en: Dina, do you know the story of Malin Kundang?
lines.id: Dina, kamu tahu cerita Malin Kundang?

lines.en: Yes, I do. A poor boy left his village and became rich. But when he came back, he was ashamed of his mother.
lines.id: Ya. Seorang anak miskin meninggalkan desanya dan menjadi kaya. Tetapi ketika dia pulang, dia malu pada ibunya.

lines.en: His mother was very angry, so she cursed him. He turned into a stone. The moral value is: respect your parents.
lines.id: Ibunya sangat marah, jadi dia mengutuknya. Anak itu berubah menjadi batu. Pesan moralnya: hormati orang tuamu.

lesson.title: Membaca cerita dengan cerdas
lesson.text: Setelah membaca, tanyakan lima hal: **Siapa** tokohnya? **Di mana dan kapan** latarnya? **Apa** masalahnya? **Bagaimana** penyelesaiannya? **Apa** pesan moralnya? Jawabannya hampir selalu ada di Orientation, Complication, dan Resolution.

items: Kejadian utama pakai **simple past**; latar kejadian pakai **past continuous**.

Setelah membaca, cari tokoh, latar, masalah, penyelesaian, dan pesan moral.

read.id:
Dahulu kala, seorang janda miskin tinggal bersama putranya, Malin Kundang, di sebuah desa nelayan di Sumatra Barat. Malin ingin menjadi kaya, jadi dia pergi ke kota besar dengan kapal. Ibunya menangis, tetapi dia mengizinkannya pergi.
Bertahun-tahun kemudian, Malin menjadi pedagang kaya dan menikahi wanita cantik. Suatu hari, kapalnya tiba di desanya. Ibunya yang sudah tua berlari menghampirinya, tetapi Malin malu padanya. Dia berkata, "Aku tidak kenal wanita tua ini!" Ibunya sangat marah dan berdoa kepada Tuhan. Tiba-tiba, badai datang dan mengubah Malin menjadi batu.

options: He wanted to see the sea.
qs.q: Why did Malin go to a big city?
How did Malin feel when he saw his mother?

options: He went back to the city.
qs.q: What happened to Malin at the end?
What is the moral of the story?

read.text:
Long ago, a poor widow lived with her son, Malin Kundang, in a fishing village in West Sumatra. Malin wanted to be rich, so he went to a big city on a ship. His mother cried, but she let him go.
Years later, Malin became a rich merchant and married a beautiful woman. One day, his ship arrived at his village. His old mother ran to him, but Malin was ashamed of her. He said, "I do not know this old woman!" His mother was very angry and prayed to God. Suddenly, a storm came and turned Malin into a stone.
read.title: Malin Kundang

read.id:
Suatu hari, seekor singa sedang tidur di hutan ketika seekor tikus kecil berlari di atas wajahnya. Singa itu terbangun dan menangkap tikus itu. "Tolong lepaskan aku," kata tikus. "Suatu hari aku akan menolongmu." Singa itu tertawa, tetapi dia melepaskan tikus itu.
Beberapa hari kemudian, singa itu terjebak di jaring pemburu. Dia mengaum keras. Tikus mendengarnya dan berlari menghampirinya. Dia menggigit tali dengan giginya yang tajam sampai singa itu bebas. "Terima kasih," kata singa. "Bahkan teman kecil pun bisa sangat membantu."

qs.exp: Teks: "a little mouse ran over his face."
options: A mouse ran over his face.
qs.q: Why did the lion wake up?

qs.exp: Teks: "One day I will help you."
options: To help the lion one day
qs.q: What did the mouse promise?
How did the mouse help the lion?
What is the moral of the story?

read.text:
One day, a lion was sleeping in the forest when a little mouse ran over his face. The lion woke up and caught the mouse. "Please let me go," said the mouse. "One day I will help you." The lion laughed, but he let the mouse go.
A few days later, the lion was trapped in a hunter's net. He roared loudly. The mouse heard him and ran to him. She chewed the ropes with her sharp teeth until the lion was free. "Thank you," said the lion. "Even a small friend can be a great help."
read.title: The Lion and the Mouse

read.focus: Simple past dan past continuous dalam narasi
read.id:
Dahulu kala, seorang nelayan miskin tinggal di tepi laut. Suatu pagi, ketika dia sedang memperbaiki jaringnya, dia menangkap seekor ikan emas. Ikan itu berkata, "Tolong lepaskan aku, dan aku akan memberimu apa pun yang kamu mau."
Nelayan itu baik hati, jadi dia melepaskan ikan itu dan tidak meminta apa-apa. Ketika dia pulang, istrinya sedang menangis karena rumah mereka hampir runtuh. Istrinya menyuruhnya meminta rumah baru kepada ikan. Dia kembali, tetapi ikan itu sudah pergi. Mereka hidup sederhana, tetapi mereka bahagia.

qs.exp: Teks: "he was mending his net when he caught a golden fish".
options: Sleeping on the beach near his small boat
Selling fish at the busy market
Cooking dinner for his wife at home
qs.q: What was the fisherman doing when he caught the fish?

options: She lost her wedding ring at the beach.
He was late and she was angry.
They had no fish to sell at the market.
qs.q: Why did the fisherman's wife cry?

qs.exp: Konflik: rumah rusak, ikan sudah pergi.
options: The wife wants a new house but the fish is gone.
The fisherman catches a golden fish near the sea.
The fisherman goes to sea early in the morning.
The fish speaks and asks to be released.
qs.q: What is the complication in the story?

pairs: A poor fisherman lived by the sea.
The wife cried because the house was falling apart.
qs.q: Pasangkan bagian cerita dengan isinya:

qs.exp: Kegiatan berlangsung lalu terpotong → was + V-ing.
qs.q: The fisherman ___ (mend) his net when he caught the fish.
The fisherman ___ (release) the fish.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia melepaskan ikan itu."

read.text:
Once upon a time, a poor fisherman lived by the sea. One morning, he was mending his net when he caught a golden fish. The fish said, "Please let me go, and I will give you anything you want."
The fisherman was kind, so he released the fish and asked for nothing. When he got home, his wife was crying because their house was falling apart. She told him to ask the fish for a new house. He went back, but the fish was gone. They lived simply, but they were happy.
read.title: The Fisherman and the Golden Fish

read.id:
Suatu pagi, Sita tiba di sekolah dan menyadari bahwa dia telah kehilangan kunci rumahnya. Dia sudah memeriksa tasnya dua kali sebelum berangkat, jadi dia yakin sudah membawanya. Dia merasa khawatir.
Siang harinya, temannya Lina menelepon. Dia telah menemukan sebuah kunci di bus, dan dia telah menyimpannya dengan aman untuk Sita. Sita begitu sibuk sampai tidak menyadari kunci itu jatuh. Dia berterima kasih pada Lina sepenuh hati dan berjanji lebih berhati-hati.

qs.exp: Teks: "She had found a key on the bus".
qs.q: Where did Lina find the key?

qs.exp: Sebelum kejadian lampau lain → had checked, bukan has checked.
options: She has checked her bag twice before she left home.
She had lost her house key.
She had checked her bag twice.
Lina had kept the key safely.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Which happened first?
Pasangkan kata kerja dengan past participle:

qs.exp: Sebelum kejadian lampau lain → had + V3.
qs.q: Sita realized that she ___ (lose) her key.

qs.exp: Sudah dilakukan sebelum telepon → had + V3.
qs.q: Lina ___ (keep) the key safely for Sita.

qs.answer: She had checked her bag twice.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia sudah memeriksa tasnya dua kali."

read.text:
One morning, Sita arrived at school and realized that she had lost her house key. She had checked her bag twice before she left home, so she was sure that she had taken it. She felt worried.
At noon, her friend Lina called. She had found a key on the bus, and she had kept it safely for Sita. Sita had been so busy that she had not noticed it fall. She thanked Lina with all her heart and promised to be more careful.
read.title: The Missing Key

read.focus: Narasi: past perfect continuous dan past simple
read.id:
Rani: Ayah, ceritakan sebuah cerita. Ayah: Dahulu ada seorang gadis bernama Lia. Dia sudah berjalan di hutan selama berjam-jam ketika menemukan rumah kecil. Dia mencari anjingnya yang hilang, dan dia sangat lelah.
Ayah: Seorang wanita tua membuka pintu. Dia berkata, "Aku sudah menunggumu." Lia terkejut. Wanita tua itu telah merawat anjing itu selama dua hari. Lia memeluknya dan berterima kasih. Rani: Akhir yang bahagia!

qs.exp: Dad: "She had been looking for her lost dog".
options: She was looking for her lost dog.
qs.q: Why was Lia in the forest?

options: She had been walk in the forest for hours.
She had been walking in the forest for hours.
The old woman opened the door.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
How long had the old woman taken care of the dog?
Pasangkan bentuk dengan fungsinya:

qs.exp: for hours + sebelum kejadian lampau → had been + V-ing.
qs.q: She ___ (walk) in the forest for hours when she found a house.
Lia ___ (hug) the dog and thanked her.

qs.answer: The dog had been looked after for two days.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Anjing itu sudah dirawat selama dua hari."

read.text:
Rani: Dad, tell me a story. Dad: Once there was a girl named Lia. She had been walking in the forest for hours when she found a small house. She had been looking for her lost dog, and she was very tired.
Dad: An old woman opened the door. She said, "I have been waiting for you." Lia was surprised. The old woman had been taking care of the dog for two days. Lia hugged him and thanked her. Rani: What a happy ending!
read.title: The Story at Bedtime
